# Independent conformance fixtures

`pngsuite/` is Willem van Schaik's PNGSuite, mirrored from image-rs/image-png
commit `b2f10c6a7e3127d4aaf231f3eae731a33e6eb0bc` on 2026-10-26.
The original README and license accompany the fixtures. Source:
<https://github.com/image-rs/image-png/tree/b2f10c6a7e3127d4aaf231f3eae731a33e6eb0bc/tests/pngsuite>.
Original project: <http://www.schaik.com/pngsuite/>.

The corpus is test data only; no reference codec code is used in production.
